summary_1line: During cosmic dissolution Vishnu creates Brahma and slays Madhu and Kaitabha; later their son Dhundhu gains a boon and threatens the worlds until Kuvalaswa marches against him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu lies in yogic sleep upon the coiled serpent Sesha on the cosmic ocean while a radiant lotus rises from his navel bearing four‑faced Brahma.
Vishnu lifts the demons Madhu and Kaitabha onto his bare thighs and severs their heads with the spinning discus amid the primeval waters.
King Kuvalaswa marches across the desert sea of sands with his thousands of sons as gods in the sky shower flowers and celestial drums sound.
